Vendored dependency for the Bureau canvas extension.

- `yaml.mjs`: `yaml@2.7.0` ESM bundle
- Source: https://esm.sh/yaml@2.7.0/es2022/yaml.bundle.mjs
- Package license: ISC, from https://www.npmjs.com/package/yaml/v/2.7.0

This file is committed so the extension codec works offline without a package
manager, bundler, or `package.json`.
